title: The integration-test Redis is on host port 6380, not 6379
body:
## Integration-test Redis port

`docker-compose.test.yml` publishes the test stack's Redis on host port 6380 (`"6380:6379"`) so it can run alongside the dev stack from `docker-compose.yml`, which keeps 6379. `services/api/.env.test` sets `REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6380` to match.

Code that hard-codes `redis://localhost:6379` works against the dev stack but fails under `pnpm --filter api test:integration` with `Error: connect ECONNREFUSED 127.0.0.1:6379`.

## What to do

In `services/api`, get a Redis client from `getRedis()` in `src/lib/redis.ts`, which reads `REDIS_URL`, instead of constructing one from a literal URL.
